notes: Mixed-basis report: governmental funds modified cash basis (FY ending 9/30/2022), proprietary funds (Light, Water, Sewer) accrual basis (FY ending 4/30/2022). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds 2022 column (p6). Intergovernmental revenues 1,194,011 split by the printed fund-schedule rows (General p11 561,777, Street p14 584,254, Bond p29 47,980; exact). Charges for services/reimbursements 980,351 split by fund column (Landfill 864,493, Street 47,266, Non-Major 68,592 = Pool 55,797 + Library 1,865 + Community Building 10,930; exact). Debt service 82,138 split from the Bond fund schedule (p29: professional fees 4,746 + interest paid 77,392; principal paid 0). Landfill Fund interest 6,278 and principal 31,151 printed under Other financing sources (uses): other_financing -37,429; Loan proceedds 167,850 there too: debt_proceeds. Roll-forward ties on fund balance: 6,202,322 + 6,040,835 - 4,525,060 + 1,831,122 - 1,510,608 + 167,850 - 37,429 = 8,169,032. Cash and fund balance are separate: cash = cash and cash equivalents + cash with county treasurer (p4, 2022 and 2021 columns), certificates of deposit in *_investments. Grants/awards with no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants (user ruling 2026-11-12). Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position (p8), net position measure; operating Miscellaneous counted in Charges for Services on p2; disbursement total 9,787,302 printed on p2. Proprietary cash flows from Totals 2022 column (p10). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), zero cells omitted. Detail: per-fund budget schedules (Sch 1-5, 10-17, 19, 21); zero-actual lines kept only where a budget figure is printed. Schedule 22 combined budget comparison (p31, fund totals incl. transfers and fiduciary Trust and Agency) not recorded to avoid double counting. No proprietary budget schedule in this trim and the later years have no statement-column business-type detail, so no business-type detail. Capital outlay function only where the fund name names it (General, Equipment Reserve, Keno, Grant Projects, Sales Tax, Bond: plain Capital Outlay). Read pages 1-31 of 31
